method: v002 scene plus colour-coded footprint blockout of every planned placement, Codex-style studio render (BlenderSource/TownLife09/build_town_layout_v003.py --concept-only); no AI image model in the cloud session.

images.prompt: Layout concept for the dondon xianxia town north block: v002 town unchanged in the south; raised grass terrace with stone retaining wall and balustrade; north street of 6 m stone road tiles with crossroads, archway and T junction; inn to the west, well square to the east, fenced lotus garden north-east, waypoint altar by the archway.
